2.3.1.summary: Rebuild of 2.3.0 from the recovered recording specification; originals unavailable; named junk refused directly.

3.0.0.summary: Archive General: registered filesystem targets, pinned SSD identity, generic indexes, checked ExFAT/cross-device publication and one consolidated skill.

3.1.0.summary: Direct Google Drive API: resumable uploads with preallocated IDs, verified cloud bytes and durable local/cloud maps before source removal, format-3 receipts, checked restore/recovery; filesystem formats 1/2 retained.

3.1.1.summary: Direct Drive patch: verified resumable format-3 archives, cloud-record-before-unlink order, multi-scope restore preflight, retained packing intent and explicit API-root recovery; formats 1/2 stay readable.

3.1.2.summary: Direct Drive format 3 with verified resumable upload and durable cloud records before source removal, configuration adoption, scoped restore, preserved packing intent, and safe frozen-reader lock handoff. Existing filesystem formats remain readable.

3.1.3.summary: Direct Google Drive with verified resumable format-3 uploads and cloud records before local removal, identity-pinned configuration recovery, safe scoped/frozen restore, and verification reporting restricted to completed files.

3.1.4.summary: Tidy step after every sync/restore and after refused runs; REFUSED does not mean nothing moved; unreadable macOS-protected folders need Full Disk Access.

3.2.0.summary: Batched repo locking: sync/restore reuse one Store per ~10 s batch (was rereading both manifests per file, quadratic) with a fair 0.25 s yield between batches; per-file target check retained. Same format 2 layout; zip mode recorded in references/future-ideas.md.

3.2.1.summary: APFS-compressed sources: copy without the UF_COMPRESSED flag where the target (ExFAT) refuses it; bytes, mode and mtime unchanged.

3.3.0.summary: Nested archive scopes: a folder of a project can keep its own index on another target (e.g. most of a project on Google Drive, one folder on the SSD); parent operations never enter or park a nested scope.

3.3.1.summary: Nested scopes: upgrade naming a nested scope now runs on that scope (3.3.0 sent it to the parent).

3.4.0.summary: Nested scopes park their emptied folders in the project's shared park at _archive/<scope path>/ (recorded in the marker); the parent never moves, counts or removes that part; _archive/<scope>/x paths route to the scope. Status wording no longer says iCloud for other targets.

3.5.0.summary: restore --into a folder outside the project (moves between places/targets), import CSV carries sha256/mode/mtime, scope remove, copy-fallback publication keeps the owner mark (ExFAT Drive restores)

3.6.0.summary: Whole-project direct-Drive to SSD moves with empty-index retargeting, fresh GET-only metadata batches, and journalled parallel restore into destination staging; formats 2 and 3 unchanged.
